name: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation
summary: Mumbai's city government, which owns and maintains the roads inside the city and built the Coastal Road.
about: The BMC runs Mumbai's streets, water, drains and hospitals, and is among the richest municipal bodies in India. Most roads inside the city limits are its responsibility, which means potholes, resurfacing and monsoon flooding are complaints it handles. Its largest road project by far is the Mumbai Coastal Road along the western shoreline, built with tunnels and reclaimed land to give the city a fast north–south route away from the crowded streets inland.
facts: One of the oldest municipal corporations in India, dating from 1888.
Built the Mumbai Coastal Road, including twin tunnels under Malabar Hill.
Handles pothole and road-condition complaints for streets inside Mumbai.

grievance.note: The corporation takes pothole and road complaints through its portal and its own app.
